# ibdrel

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

**ibdrel** is an R package and a Shiny application for estimating and rankig pairwise genetic relationships from genomic segments shared *identical by descent* (IBD).


## Installation

You can install the development version of ibdrel from [GitHub](https://github.com/hnordto/ibdrel) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("hnordto/ibdrel")
```

## Shiny application

The **ibdrel** Shiny application can be run as follows:

```{r eval = F}
ibdrel::launchApp()
```
